content.page_description: Reference list entries (590-597) from a clinical guideline or review focused on ventricular arrhythmias, ventricular tachycardia/fibrillation, myocardial infarction, and related interventions/outcomes.

references.citation: Wolfe CL, Nibley C, Bhandari A, Chatterjee K, Scheinman M. Polymorphous ventricular tachycardia associated with acute myocardial infarction. Circulation 1991;84:1543-1551.
references.short_summary: Describes occurrence/characteristics of polymorphous ventricular tachycardia in the setting of acute myocardial infarction.

references.citation: Liang JJ, Fender EA, Cha YM, Lennon RJ, Prasad A, Barsness GW, et al. Long-term outcomes in survivors of early ventricular arrhythmias after acute ST-elevation and non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction treated with percutaneous coronary intervention. Am J Cardiol 2016;117:709-713.
references.short_summary: Evaluates long-term outcomes in survivors who had early ventricular arrhythmias after acute MI treated with PCI.

references.citation: Mehta RH, Yu J, Piccini JP, Tcheng JE, Farkouh ME, Reiffel J, et al. Prognostic significance of postprocedural sustained ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation in patients undergoing primary percutaneous coronary intervention (from the HORIZONS-AMI Trial). Am J Cardiol 2012;109:805-812.
references.short_summary: Assesses prognostic impact of sustained VT/VF occurring after primary PCI in the HORIZONS-AMI cohort.

references.citation: Masuda M, Nakatani D, Hikoso S, Suna S, Usami M, Matsumoto S, et al. Clinical impact of ventricular tachycardia and/or fibrillation during the acute phase of acute myocardial infarction on in-hospital and 5-year mortality rates in the percutaneous coronary intervention era. Circ J 2016;80:1539-1547.
references.short_summary: Examines how VT/VF during the acute phase of MI affects short- and long-term mortality in the PCI era.

references.citation: Podolecki T, Lenarczyk R, Kowalczyk J, Jedrzejczyk-Patej E, Chodor P, Mazurek M, et al. Prognostic significance of complex ventricular arrhythmias complicating ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. Am J Cardiol 2018;121:805-809.
references.short_summary: Reports on prognostic implications of complex ventricular arrhythmias occurring with STEMI.

references.citation: Komatsu Y, Hocini M, Nogami A, Maury P, Peichl P, Iwasaki YK, et al. Catheter ablation of refractory ventricular fibrillation storm after myocardial infarction. Circulation 2019;139:2315-2325.
references.short_summary: Describes catheter ablation as a treatment for refractory VF storm following MI.

references.citation: Terkelsen CJ, Sørensen JT, Kaltoft AK, Nielsen SS, Thuesen L, Bækker HE, et al. Prevalence and significance of accelerated idioventricular rhythm in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction treated with primary percutaneous coronary intervention. Am J Cardiol 2009;104:1641-1646.
references.short_summary: Evaluates prevalence and clinical significance of accelerated idioventricular rhythm in STEMI patients treated with primary PCI.

references.citation: Mehran R, Pocock SJ, Nikolsky E, Clayton T, Dangas GD, Kirtane AJ, et al. A risk score to predict bleeding in patients with acute coronary syndromes. J Am Coll Cardiol 2010;55:2556-2566.
references.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
references.short_summary: Presents a risk score for predicting bleeding in patients with acute coronary syndromes.
